reason: A better addresses high-contact-stress service while plausibly preserving bulk ductility and toughness through a surface-localized treatment; its compressive-stress/work-hardening mechanism is more defensible than B’s underdefined Ni-containing coating and unsupported claim that Ni mitigates brittleness.
